description: This file contains internal utility functions for memory-based string operations in the Abseil C++ library, including functions like memcat, memcasecmp, memdup, memrchr, and internal matching templates, used for string manipulation and comparison.

methods.name: memcat
methods.description: Concatenates src to dest at position destlen, returning dest.

methods.name: memcasecmp
methods.description: Performs case-insensitive comparison of two memory blocks.

methods.name: memdup
methods.description: Duplicates a memory block into a new allocated string.

methods.name: memrchr
methods.description: Finds the last occurrence of a character in a memory block.

methods.name: memspn
methods.description: Calculates the length of the initial segment of s consisting only of accept characters.

methods.name: memcspn
methods.description: Calculates the length of the initial segment of s consisting only of reject characters.

methods.name: mempbrk
methods.description: Finds the first occurrence in s of any of the characters in accept.

methods.name: int_memmatch
methods.description: Internal template for matching memory blocks with optional case sensitivity.

methods.name: memstr
methods.description: Finds a substring within a memory block, case-sensitive.

methods.name: memcasestr
methods.description: Finds a substring within a memory block, case-insensitive.

methods.name: memmem
methods.description: Finds a substring within a memory block, with specified length, case-sensitive.

methods.name: memcasemem
methods.description: Finds a substring within a memory block, with specified length, case-insensitive.

methods.name: memmatch
methods.description: Fast case-sensitive memory match with few possible matches.
